title: Lines added from ShopCoach keep the title and description shown in the builder
custom_preconds:
Setup (manual QA tester and Claude session)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as an Admin (all permissions) at {Location-A} (for example Staging Heavy Duty - 9919) on the What/Why QA build.
  • Customer {Customer-A} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-WW-C154712 Fleet) has a contact person and an asset, {Asset-A} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-WW-C154712 Truck).
  • Work order {Work-order-1} (for example S2-15440) is open for {Customer-A} and {Asset-A} at {Location-A}, not invoiced.
  • {Asset-A} has a year, make and model filled in (for example 2018 Freightliner Cascadia), so ShopCoach can suggest lines for it.
custom_steps:
1. Open {Work-order-1} and go to its Lines tab.
  2. Click New Line.
  3. Click AI SHOPCOACH LINE BUILDER.
  4. Describe the job (for example brakes grinding) and click Build Lines.
  5. Wait until suggested lines appear.
  6. Write down the first suggested line's title and description exactly as the table shows them.
  7. Add the first suggested line to {Work-order-1} with the builder's add button.
  8. Find the added line on the Lines tab.
  9. Click its title to open Edit Line.
  10. Read the Title and Description fields.
  11. Close the window without saving.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 7: the line is added and listed on the Lines tab.
  • Step 10: Title and Description read exactly what you wrote down in step 6, with nothing added, cut or reworded.
  • Step 10: neither value contains "What are you doing?" or "Why are you doing it?".

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-11257; story SV-10131 (Story 2, The ShopCoach Line Builder); PRD "What Are You Doing / Why Are You Doing It (What/Why)", Confluence 845348896, version of 13 Oct 2026, S2-R3, read 13 Oct 2026; no design board exists for this story (tech plan: Story 2 and Story 4 are text-only), labels from the Jira story and tech plan; tech plan "Title and Description - Technical Implementation Plan" (dated 2026-09-23, shared by the QA lead 13 Oct 2026), FR-007; Source-verified 13 October 2026; not yet build-verified (a What/Why QA build exists; verification by the build verification session).

  • S2-R3: “What ShopCoach generates and writes into a line is unchanged. A generated line becomes an ordinary work order line and follows Story 3 like any other.”
  • SV-10131 acceptance criteria: “Given a line is generated by ShopCoach, then the values written into the work order line are the same as before this change.”
  • Tech plan FR-007: “What ShopCoach generates and writes into a line is unchanged (S2-R3).”
